description: Refreshing the MCP servers panel removes a pending deletion when an integration takes ownership of the server. The screen is the default 393x727 phone. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means the name is exactly X. To "open the panel": navigate to /new, press Control+k, fill ".command-palette-input" with "MCP Servers", and click the first ".command-palette-item"; "the panel", the dialog named "MCP Servers" (the element [role="dialog"]:has(.modal-xwide)), should be visible. The server lists one MCP server, "kagi", not managed by an integration; call "manage" makes the integration kagi-mcp manage it from then on. Perform the steps in order. 1. Open the panel. 2. Click the panel's button named "Delete kagi": its button named "Delete" should be visible. 3. Call "manage", then click the panel's button named "Refresh". 4. The element in the panel whose text is exactly "kagi" should be visible, and the panel must have no button whose name starts with "Delete" (count 0).
